title: Stratified K-Fold Assignment
signature: def stratified_k_fold(y: np.ndarray, k: int) -> np.ndarray
hints: Process the classes in ascending label order (np.unique sorts them), and each class's samples in ascending index order.
Keep one dealer position that carries over between classes. The first sample of the next class gets the fold after the one the previous class ended on.
For a class with idx = np.flatnonzero(y == c), its folds are (pos + np.arange(len(idx))) % k. Then advance pos by len(idx).
